eoe.text: Alpharael, a young Monoist, is haunted by a dream in which his sister Raphaella is torn apart falling into Sothera, and he wakes to learn her inevitor completed its transit, proving inevitors can penetrate the Free Company's defenses.
Saying he wants to die, he asks to join the next assault on the Dawnsire, where a rahu gives him a sekhar bead, and in the attack he throws the bead through Vondam's head, apparently killing him.
After the Endstone's timeline revision Vondam survives with a hole in his head and vows to pursue Alpharael, and Slats sentences Alpharael to live.

Alpharael emerges holding the stone, and a voice speaking through him says it is not a god and has limits, then reveals he has already used it to change the Hopelight's past so the Kav arrived as walking corpses.
